in_arabic.name: لزّات
in_arabic.long_meaning: اللزّة هي الحالة التي تشعر فيها الشخص بالسعادة واللذة والمرح وهي من صفات النبي محمد عليه السلام، وتتألف من ثلاثة حروف عربية هي الألف واللام والزاء، والمصدر من أَلَزَّ، والمعرب لزّأت، والفعل لزّاء، والمفعول لازّات، والمرادفات اللذة، اللذوزة، المرح، السعادة، النعيم، والصفات النبوية، والتأمل والتقدير، والاستمتاع باللذة، والراحة والاستراحة، والتواصل مع الله تعالى، والتفاؤل والرضا، والخير والبركة والفلاح

in_urdu.name: لزّات
in_urdu.long_meaning: لزّات کی عربی اشتقاقات سے لذت اور خوشی کی شے ہوتی ہے، یہ نام نبی اکرم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کے سیرت و کردار سے متاثر ہے، اس نام سے مراد خوشی اور لذت کی حالت ہوتی ہے جس میں انسان خواہشات اور ارادے کو پورا کرے، یہ نام کریم و رحمان کے ساتھ تعلق رکھتا ہے، اور خوشی اور لذت کی علامت ہوتی ہے، اور خواہشات پر عمل کرنے کا نام ہے

in_english.name: Lazzat
in_english.long_meaning: The name Lazzat is derived from the Arabic root 'l-z-z', which means pleasure, delight, enjoyment, sweetness, and happiness. It is also a name from the Quran and is one of the names of Allah. In Islamic tradition, Lazzat is associated with the Prophet Muhammad's (s.a.w.) characteristics and is a name that conveys a sense of pleasure, delight, and happiness. It is also a name that symbolizes the attainment of one's desires and the pursuit of happiness. In Islamic culture, Lazzat is considered a blessed name and is often given to children as a means of invoking Allah's blessings and guidance.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Lazzat" is a beautiful and meaningful Arabic name. It conveys the essence of something delightful, enjoyable, and pleasurable. This can be both in terms of material possessions or intangible experiences such as laughter or love. "Lazzat" is a name that evokes a sense of joy, happiness, and contentment.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, the name "Lazzat" is often associated with the pleasures of the afterlife. The Quran speaks of the Gardens of Paradise where rivers flow, delicious fruits grow, and the inhabitants will live in eternal happiness. The name "Lazzat" is an reminder of the beautiful and pleasurable experiences that await us in the hereafter. It is a reminder to strive towards living a virtuous and obedient life so that we may earn the pleasure of Allah SWT and ultimately enter Paradise. Additionally, the name "Lazzat" can also symbolize the pleasure and joy that comes from performing acts of worship and drawing closer to Allah. The Prophet Muhammad PBUH said, "Allah is pleased with you only when you are pleased with people." By being pleased with Allah and striving to be obedient to Him, we can experience the true and lasting pleasure and joy that comes from a deep connection with the Divine.
